proprioceptors.definition: superclass in ['vnc_sensory', 'sensory_ascending'] and class == 'mechanosensory_proprioceptive' (MEASURED); grouped by subclass; leg read from entryNerve (ProLN/ProAN/VProN/DProN=T1, MesoLN=T2, MetaLN=T3)
proprioceptors.not_in_annotations: Sub-populations of the femoral chordotonal organ (club, claw, hook) and of the campaniform fields are not named; the strings give the organ, the MANC type code (SNpp##/SApp##), the entry nerve and the side only.
